correctness.rationale: For n=3r the source interaction law Khat=2r/n I+r²Σ realizes [[1,chi,0],[chi,1,0],[0,0,1]] with Σ=r^-2[[1/3,chi,0],[chi,1/3,0],[0,0,1/3]], positive definite exactly for 0<chi<1/3. The actual simplified-Muon block-polar update is factor minus η times sign(factor times Khat z), z=(a²-1,b²,c²). Let δ=η²/4, t=η sqrt(8-η²)/4, q=t²=2δ-δ², 0<η<1. At X+ all factors and reduced forces are positive, so one full step subtracts η in each block to X-. At X- the forces Khat z- = (-(1-chi)q,(1-chi)q,η²/4), while factor signs are (+,-,-), so all gradient block signs are negative and the next step adds η, yielding X+. All three blocks nonzero at both endpoints, avoiding nonunique polar factors. Reduced loss at X-=(1-chi)q²+η^4/32>0, proving a real non-ground-state period-two orbit for every parameter pair. Independent checker verifies actual sign toggling and positive loss on rational/float witnesses; all-parameter proof is algebraic.
